description: This file declares the PrimaryKeyBuilder class and related functions for creating and managing TPM keys within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, used for secure environment key management.

classes.name: PrimaryKeyBuilder
classes.description: A class for building and managing TPM primary keys, including methods for creating signing and parent keys, and setting unique data.

methods.name: SigningKey
methods.description: Method to generate or configure a signing key.

methods.name: ParentKey
methods.description: Method to generate or configure a parent key.

methods.name: UniqueData
methods.description: Method to set unique data for key creation.

methods.name: CreateKey
methods.description: Creates a TPM key using the provided resource manager.

methods.name: CreateSigningKey
methods.description: Static function to create a signing key with specified unique data.

methods.name: ParentKeyCreator
methods.description: Static function to create a parent key with specified unique data.
